CREATE TABLE machines (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    process_time_s DOUBLE PRECISION,
    availability DOUBLE PRECISION,
    mttr_s DOUBLE PRECISION,
    work_power_kw DOUBLE PRECISION,
    idle_power_kw DOUBLE PRECISION
);

INSERT INTO machines (id, process_time_s, availability, mttr_s, work_power_kw, idle_power_kw) VALUES
('M1', 90, 0.99, 600, 3.0, 0.3),
('M2', 70, 0.98, 900, 4.5, 0.45),
('M3', 110, 0.99, 1200, 6.0, 0.6);

CREATE TABLE buffers (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    capacity INTEGER,
    before TEXT,
    after TEXT
);

INSERT INTO buffers (id, capacity, before, after) VALUES
('B0', 15, 'source', 'M1'),
('B1', 5, 'M1', 'M2'),
('B2', 5, 'M2', 'M3');

CREATE TABLE stations (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    processing_time_s DOUBLE PRECISION,
    availability_pct DOUBLE PRECISION,
    mttr_s DOUBLE PRECISION,
    power_working_kw DOUBLE PRECISION,
    power_idle_kw DOUBLE PRECISION
);

INSERT INTO stations (id, processing_time_s, availability_pct, mttr_s, power_working_kw, power_idle_kw) VALUES
('M1', 90, 100.0, 600, 3.0, 0.3),
('M2', 70, 99.55, 900, 4.5, 0.45),
('M3', 110, 100.0, 1200, 6.0, 0.6);

CREATE TABLE tag_map (
    tag_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    machine_id TEXT,
    signal TEXT,
    unit TEXT,
    register TEXT,
    scale DOUBLE PRECISION
);

INSERT INTO tag_map (tag_id, machine_id, signal, unit, register, scale) VALUES
('avg_processing_time', 'M1', 'Average processing time', 's', 'avg_processing_time', 1.0),
('avg_processing_time', 'M2', 'Average processing time', 's', 'avg_processing_time', 1.0),
('avg_processing_time', 'M3', 'Average processing time', 's', 'avg_processing_time', 1.0),
('availability', 'M1', 'Availability', '%', 'availability', 1.0),
('availability', 'M2', 'Availability', '%', 'availability', 1.0),
('availability', 'M3', 'Availability', '%', 'availability', 1.0),
('mttr', 'M1', 'MTTR', 's', 'mttr', 1.0),
('mttr', 'M2', 'MTTR', 's', 'mttr', 1.0),
('mttr', 'M3', 'MTTR', 's', 'mttr', 1.0),
('idle_power', 'M1', 'Idle power', 'kW', 'idle_power', 1.0),
('idle_power', 'M2', 'Idle power', 'kW', 'idle_power', 1.0),
('idle_power', 'M3', 'Idle power', 'kW', 'idle_power', 1.0);

CREATE TABLE raw_ingest (
    ingested_at TIMESTAMPTZ PRIMARY KEY,
    source TEXT,
    payload JSONB
);

CREATE TABLE events (
    ts TIMESTAMPTZ,
    machine_id TEXT,
    reason_code TEXT,
    duration_s DOUBLE PRECISION,
    energy_kwh DOUBLE PRECISION,
    PRIMARY KEY (machine_id, ts)
);

CREATE TABLE samples (
    ts TIMESTAMPTZ,
    machine_id TEXT,
    tag TEXT,
    value DOUBLE PRECISION,
    PRIMARY KEY (machine_id, ts, tag)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_events_machine_time ON events (machine_id, ts);
CREATE INDEX idx_samples_machine_time ON samples (machine_id, ts);

CREATE TABLE ingest_watermark (
    source TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    max_event_ts TIMESTAMPTZ
);
